sources.title: NHTSA Opens Investigation into Tesla Cybercab Self-Certification Following Austin Deployment

sources.limitations: An open Audit Query is an ongoing compliance inquiry, not a finding of defect, noncompliance, unsafe operation, recall, or stop-service order.

sources.title: Waymo Consolidated TCP Certificate, August 11 2023
